evidence.scope: Confirmed single Application PN space; RTT state supplied at this observation; no PTO exponential factor.
evidence.integration: Caller must track unconsumed loss declarations and persistent episodes before applying minimum cwnd. evidence_key describes a span but is not sufficient for deduplication: late ACK can split old spans without new loss. Late ACKs do not automatically undo a prior action.
